selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline topology discovery / physical link mapping
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed via scratch-IP ping tests that node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 and node1 eth2<->node2 eth2 are the two independent inter-node links, and node1 eth3/node2 eth3 connect to node3/node4 respectively.

selected_evidence.requirement: Redundant bond built and both links actively carrying traffic between the private networks
selected_evidence.summary: bond0 (balance-rr) built from eth1+eth2 on both node1 and node2, private subnets routed over it, and node3<->node4 ping traffic shown split near-equally across eth1/eth2 TX counters (104/104 packets), proving both links are actively used.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3/node4 stay reachable when either link is taken out of service
selected_evidence.summary: With Link A fully down (both ends) node3->node4 ping showed 0% loss (10/10) over Link B alone; with Link B fully down node3->node4 ping showed 0% loss (8/8) over Link A alone; both links then restored and reconfirmed active on both bonds with balanced TX traffic (50/50 packets).

selected_evidence.requirement: Configuration persistence set up before restart protocol
selected_evidence.summary: systemd redundant-uplink.service enabled on node1/node2 (confirmed idempotent via manual systemctl start), and NetworkManager static profiles confirmed persistent on node3/node4.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol - node3 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 54bd1c3e captured with healthy ping; reboot acknowledged; connection timeout observed during reboot; boot_id changed to dfd47fdf on reconnect; eth1 address/route and 0%-loss ping to node4 confirmed recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol - node4 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e31962a9 captured with healthy ping; reboot acknowledged; connection timeout during reboot; boot_id changed to 046fd313 on reconnect; eth1 address/route and 0%-loss ping to node3 confirmed recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol - node1 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ce04f497 captured with healthy bond/route state; reboot acknowledged and observed executing (COLD shutdown in progress); connection reset then timeout during reboot; boot_id changed to 323d3a28 on reconnect; redundant-uplink.service active, bond0 both slaves up, route present, and 0%-loss ping node3->node4 confirmed recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol - node2 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5f292bc7 captured with healthy bond/route state; reboot acknowledged; connection reset/timeout cycling during reboot; boot_id changed to ff603b2a on reconnect; redundant-uplink.service active, bond0 both slaves up, route present, and clean 0%-loss ping node3->node4 (8/8) confirmed full recovery.

commands.command:
cat >/usr/local/sbin/redundant-uplink-setup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
ip addr del 240.127.1.1/24 dev docker0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set docker0 down 2>/dev/null || true

ip link add bond0 type bond mode balance-rr miimon 100 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set eth1 down
ip link set eth2 down
ip link set eth1 master bond0
ip link set eth2 master bond0
ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 up
ip addr flush dev bond0 scope global 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 172.20.0.1/30 dev bond0
ip link set bond0 up

ip addr flush dev eth3 scope global 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 192.168.10.1/24 dev eth3
ip link set eth3 up

sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.bond0.forwarding=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.eth3.forwarding=1

ip route replace 192.168.20.0/24 via 172.20.0.2 dev bond0
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/redundant-uplink-setup.sh
sh /usr/local/sbin/redundant-uplink-setup.sh
echo "exit=$?"
commands.stdout:
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding = 1
net.ipv4.conf.bond0.forwarding = 1
net.ipv4.conf.eth3.forwarding = 1
exit=0
